title: 美中商业理事会Sean Stein：中国要的是稳定，关税筹码已不再锋利？
speaker: Sean Stein

segments.en: I think what the Chinese want more than anything is the Chinese want stability, the Chinese want predictability.
segments.zh: 我认为中方最想要的是稳定，是可预测性。

segments.en: You know, on this question of leverage, I think it now is a difficult time to be ambassador Greer. He's got a big mandate and he's got a lot he wants to accomplish. But if we go back to, you know, back to say liberation day, just before liberation day, I was in China on liberation day.
segments.zh: 关于筹码问题，我认为现在对格里尔大使来说是个艰难时期。他任务很重，想做成很多事。但回想所谓解放日前后，解放日当天我就在中国。

segments.en: And in the run-up to liberation day, the Chinese had a lot of concern, a lot of fear of US tariffs. What will it do to invest? What will it do to send them? What will it do to employment? So they had real concerns.
segments.zh: 在解放日之前，中方对美国关税有很多担忧和顾虑。会对配置产生什么影响？会对企业产生什么影响？会对就业产生什么影响？他们确实有真实担忧。

segments.en: Now, a year and a half later, when you talk to the Chinese, the opinion has completely changed. There's a phrase they use in Chinese that says, you know, the thunder was loud. But the storm was not so big. And that's how they talk about tariffs now because they thought that the tariff hit was going to be big. But in fact, it didn't materialize. They have a $1.2 trillion trade surplus.
segments.zh: 一年半后，你跟中方交流，看法完全变了。他们有个说法叫雷声大、雨点小。现在他们这样形容关税，因为他们原以为关税冲击会很大，但实际上没有出现。他们有1.2万亿美元的贸易顺差。

segments.en: So what it means is the tools that Ambassador Greer has for leverage, those tools just don't have the sharp edge they once did.
segments.zh: 这意味着格里尔大使手中的筹码工具，已经不像过去那样锋利了。
